import csv, re
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('projects/smoke-06')
def rows(name):
    with (p/name).open(encoding='utf-8', newline='') as f:
        data = list(csv.reader(f))
    assert all(len(r) == len(data[0]) for r in data)
    return data[1:]
claims, sources, events = rows('claims.csv'), rows('sources.csv'), rows('events.csv')
cs = {r[0]: r for r in claims}
ss = {r[0] for r in sources}
assert len(cs) == len(claims) and len(ss) == len(sources)
for r in claims:
    assert set(filter(None, r[3].split(','))) <= ss
    assert set(filter(None, r[4].split(','))) <= cs.keys()
    for loc in r[5].split(';'):
        assert (p/loc.strip().split(':')[0]).is_file(), loc
    def visit(cid, trail):
        assert cid not in trail
        for dep in filter(None, cs[cid][4].split(',')):
            visit(dep, trail | {cid})
    visit(r[0], set())
for f in p.rglob('*.md'):
    text = f.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert set(re.findall(r'\bC\d{3,}\b', text)) <= cs.keys(), f
    assert set(re.findall(r'\bS\d{3,}\b', text)) <= ss, f
text = (p/'research/findings.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
body, table = text.rsplit('\n## ', 1)
assert set(re.findall(r'\bC\d{3,}\b', body)) <= set(re.findall(r'\bC\d{3,}\b', table))
print('OK: CSV field counts, unique IDs, references, dependency graph, usage paths, findings table')
'@ | python -B -
